zuraja34 pa95 gerdzo ba nyi :sgo:/ 3/jordo 34༄tsho/ /rigs dang dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i khyab bdag mtshungs med dpal ldan bla ma dam pa mkhan rin 21 che 'jam dpal don brgyud nyi ma'i zhabs kyi rdul dri ma med pa la spyi bos bshud de gus pas phyag 'tshal 61/ /shes dang shes bya'i chos rnams kun gyi snang ba zad pa'i mkha' dbyings su/ /zhibar zhugs kyang mtha' yas 'gro la khyab pa'i thugs rje'i sprin chen las/ /lhun grub chos kyi gru char 'jo mdzad ston mchog don kun grub de la/ /tshe rabs kun tu bstod bkur bsngags pa'i mthu ldan nyid du bdag gyur cig /phaṭ+wāṃ bde'i'abyung gnas rgyal bstan yid bzhin nor/ /ba—la ldanazhing gi rgyalamatshan rtser bkod de/ /zhi bde'i sezlos kyi dbul ba 'joms mdzad pa'i/ /rgyal kun snying rde' rang gzugs mchog der 'dud/ /btsan po'i khrims kyes sgrogs pa'i chad lta'i chang / /nan gyis 'thung bas myos 1

'jam pal 4tshe ba nyi mi'i mdza mdag 'joms par byed pa'i sman gyi mchog lta bu 'di nyid/nyon mongs pa'i mun pa stug po'i khrod na gnas shing / sdug bsngal gsum gyi nad kyis kun tu mnar ba'i nyam thag pa'i 'gro ba 'di dag la sman pa'i slad du/ 'jig rten gyi khams 'dir ji ltar gnas shing rgyas pa ni/ lung chos sde snod gsum la 'chad nyan dang / rtogs chos bslab pa gsum po la nyams len bya ba la rag las pa gsungs pas/ don che ba de dag gi tshul las brtsams te nyung bsdus tsam zhig 'god pa la gnyis te/ sku bltams nas gsan bsam nyams bzhes gnang tshul dang / de nyid bstan pa dang 'gro ba'i don du ji ltar spel tshul lo/ /dang po ni/dga' ldan la sogs dag pa'i zhing gzhan du/ /bde chen gar gyis gnas zhes smon ci 'tshal/ /yul dus dman pa'i gdul bya la dgongs nas/ /bsam bzhin srid pa bzung 'dis bdag yid drangs/ /mdo khams stod kyi cha nor chung 3

'jam pal 4tshe ba nyi mi'i mdza mdag 'joms par byed pa'i sman gyi mchog lta bu 'di nyid/nyon mongs pa'i mun pa stug po'i khrod na gnas shing / sdug bsngal gsum gyi nad kyis kun tu mnar ba'i nyam thag pa'i 'gro ba 'di dag la sman pa'i slad du/ 'jig rten gyi khams 'dir ji ltar gnas shing rgyas pa ni/ lung chos sde snod gsum la 'chad nyan dang / rtogs chos bslab pa gsum po la nyams len bya ba la rag las pa gsungs pas/ don che ba de dag gi tshul las brtsams te nyung bsdus tsam zhig 'god pa la gnyis te/ sku bltams nas gsan bsam nyams bzhes gnang tshul dang / de nyid bstan pa dang 'gro ba'i don du ji ltar spel tshul lo/ /dang po ni/dga' ldan la sogs dag pa'i zhing gzhan du/ /bde chen gar gyis gnas zhes smon ci 'tshal/ /yul dus dman pa'i gdul bya la dgongs nas/ /bsam bzhin srid pa bzung 'dis bdag yid drangs/ /mdo khams stod kyi cha nor chung 3

'jam pal 4te ba nyi mi'i mdza mastod mang chung nang du/ las dang smon lam gyis 'brel ba'i gdul bya 'dul ba'i dus la babs pa ste/ rab byung bco lnga pa'i mig dmar zhes pa shing pho byi ba'i lor/ yab nya shul tshe dbang bkra shis dang / yum a chos te rigs rus phun sum tshogs pa'i sras su sku 'brungs/ cog grwa sku phreng bdun pa chos kyi rgyal mtshan mchog gi dngos slob sgrub bla dpag bsam rgya mtsho mchog nas mtshan dge legs rgya mtsho zhes gsol/dgung lo lnga la phebs skabs klog bslabs pas de tsam lob skyen pa zhig min zhes gsung ngo / bdag nyid che rnams ji ltar smon pa'i gnas/ /theg mchog dge ba'i bshes kyis rjes bzungs nas/ /tshul gnas thos bsam bsgoms pas rgyud sbyangs te/ /don gnyis bsgrub pa'i tshul la ngang gis zhugs/ /dgung lo bcu gcig la phebs skabs bla ma dpag bsam rgya mtsho mchog mkha' 'gro 4

'jam pal 4sna ba nyi mi'i mdza mganam rdzong du sku mtshams lo gsum bzhugs ring sku mdun du bcar/ blo ldog rnam bzhi dang / skyabs 'gro maṇ+ḍal/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor bcas kyi khrid lung zhus te/ 'bum bzhi cha gnyis dang bcas pas bsags sbyang gi sgo nas sngon du blo chos su 'gro ba'i thabs la thugs sbyang gnang /rje nyid kyis de dus shes rgyud kyi steng nas gnad smin rang ma byung gsungs pa ni/ gdams pa mang du thos dgos pa'i bslab bya gnang ba'o/ /thun bar rnams su bzang spyod sogs bsngo smon gyi dpe cha rnams thugs 'dzin gnang /nags na tshang grwa rgan dkar dge dang mnyam du nā ro'i chos drug gi khrid rags rim tsam zhus/ rlung sbyor cha tsam dang 'brel bsre 'pho'i 'khrul 'khor tshul bzhin du bslabs/rtogs ldan shakyu shrī ri'i dngos slob chos dpal la rgyug 'bul yang zhus te shin tu dag par mdzad do/ /dam pa'i tshul la ngang gis 'jug go zhes/ /bdag nyid chen 5

'jam pal 4te ba nyi mi'i mdza mapo rnams la ci ste smon/ /ring nas goms pa'i shugs 'di thugs bskyed dang / /rnam dkar gdul bya'i las kyis drangs min nam/ /dgung 'o1 bcu bzhir bzhes skabs bla ma dpag bsam rgya mtsho dang lhan du 'dzi sgar kong sprul rin po che'i sku 'khor du zur mang rnam rgyal rtser phebs/ mchog gling gdung rgyud bla ma bsam gtan rgya mtsho dang / 'chi med rdo rje gnyis kyi mdun nas/ zla ba du ma'i ring / zab gnad kha shas ma gtogs mchog gling gter ma pod nyer bzhi tsam gyi dbang lung yongs rdzogs bzhes/ 'dzi sgar kong sprul rin po che las dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa zhus/ mtshan dge legs rnam rgyal zhes gsol/ de nas kong sprul rin po che ri bo che'i phyogs su phebs/ sku nyid dang dpag bsam rgya mtsho sogs 'ga' zhig gis zur mang 'brug pa sprul sku'i mdun nas dpal phag mo gru pa'i gsung 'bum pod chen bzhi dang /phyag chen nges don rgya mtsho/ do ha mdzod kyi 'grel ba/ ma 6

'jam pal 4sna ba nyi mi'i mdza mgacig rnam bshad/ zur gcod skor bcas kyi lung gsan/de nas rang yul du zhabs sor bkod de phyag bris 'bri rgyu sbyangs/ zur mang mkhan po tshogs gnyis mdun nas mnga' paṇa sdom gsum gyi dpe khrid zhib par zhus gnang mdzad do/ /dka' bas bsags pa'i mang thos nor bu mchog /tshul bzhin sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan rtser mchod pas/ /shes rab gsum gyi dgos 'dod 'byung ngo zhes/ /skal ldan tshogs la nan gyis gdam par snang / dgung grangs bco brgyad bzhes tshe/ bla ma dpag bsam rgya mtshos sgrub dpon gnang ste 'dzi sgar ldem chen sgrub sde gsar 'dzugs skabs/ sgrub grwa lnga yod pa'i khongs su bzhugs/sngon 'gro'i khrid rgyas bsdus dang / chos drug rgyas bsdus bcas kyi zhib khrid legs par gsan te/ sngon 'gro gtso bo blo sbyong dang 'brel bas 'bum bzhi cha bzhi dang / phag mo 7

'jam pal 4te ba nyi mi'i mdza malhan skyes kyi grangs bsnyen song nas/ gtum mo sogs chos drug la 'bad 'bungs gnang / gzhan grwa rog rnams la bsre 'pho'i 'khrul 'khor tshul bzhin du bslabs/ chags med gcod pod/ nyer mkho'i gto yig skor/ bsngo smon skor bcas kyi lung gsan/ gcod kyi tshogs brgya yang 'bul gnang mdzad de sgrub grwa nas re zhig grol lo/ /gang la gang 'dul ngag nas smra bzhin du/ /dgon gnas grwa tshang smod pa'i g.yag zhar la/ /gsar bu'i tshogs rnams grong du rgyu ba las/ /chos kyi khrims su bcug na legs tshul bstan/ /dgung grangs bco brgyad la phebs tshe/ 'brug pa bka' brgyud kyi gdan sa chen po 'dzi bkra shis thub bstan chos 'khor bshad sgrub dge 'phel gling du zhugs mdzad de/dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis yongs rdzogs zla ba brgyad dgu tsam gyis mthar chags su thugs 'dzin gnang bas sngon nas goms pa'i rang rtags su 'dug ces gleng / dgon 8

'jam pal 4tshe ba nyi mi'i mdza mapa'i sgrigs bzhin thab g.yog chu len lo gcig ring mdzad do/ /dkor nag chu bzhin 'jang ba'i sngon 'gro'i ched/ /grangs dang dus kyi phreng rdog brtsi ba 'di/ /rtogs pa'i bstan pa rdzogs pa'i sngon rtags kyi/ /rtas ngan yin zhes mdzad pa'i tshul 'dis gleng / /dgung grangs nyer gcig la phebs skabs slar yang ldem chen sgrub sder lo gsum bzhugs te/chos drug nyams bzhes gtso bor mdzad de/ thugs rgyud du bskyed pa dang rdzogs pa'i rim pa las byung ba'i dga' bde'i ros khengs pa'i myong ba skyes/ sbyor dngos rjes kyi dmigs rim sogs la nan tan ci cher dang yongs su 'brelabs bde mchog lhan skyes dang / dgongs gter gu drag chosagling phur pa bcas kyi bsnyen pa'ang bskyal/ /yongs rdzogs rgyal bstan shar ri'i phrag pa nas/ /rnam dag nges par 'byung ba'i skya rengs kyis/ /legs par drangs 9

'jam pal 4tshe ba nyi mi'i mdza mapa'i chos 'dul nyin mor byed/ /skal bzang skye bo'i bgo skal bdag gir mdzad/ /dgung grangs nyer gnyis phebs skabs rgyal sprul rin po che 'dzi sgar sgrub sder gdan drangs pas/ de'i sku mdun nas rab byung dang / lnga tshogs las bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa bzhes/ mtshan bsam gtan mchogagrub blo bzang gsol/ zur mang mkhan po bya bral mchog gsal zhabs kyi sku mdun nas/ gdams ngag mdzod kyi ljags lung legs par gsan/ gcod kyi tshogs brgya zhib rgyas bcas sgrub grwa'i bcad rgya las re zhig grol lo/ /'chi kar phan pa'i chos shig bya dgos zhes/ /dam pa'i chos las nges par 'byung ba yi/ /blo chung phan btags rnams la gdams pa'i gter/ /nyams len gnad la bslab gsum tshang bar mdzad/ /lo der dbyar gnas dbu mdzad gnang /dbyar nang du mkhan po chos mchog gi sku mdun nas kun mkhyen pad dkar gyi spyod 'jug 'grel ba'i khrid gsan/10

'jam pal 4sna ba nyi mi'i mdza ma dgun gyi chos mtshams tshe rdzong gsar du phebs te mkhyen brtse rin po che mjal/zhi bsil chos kyi phung po ji snyed kun/ /thar 'dod rnams la gdams dang rjes bstan gyi/ /bdud rtsi nyid phyir rnam par grol ba'i lus//dar ba'i don du ngoms med cis mi 'thung //kaḥthog mkhan po tshul khrims nyi ma'i mdun nas/ gzhan dga'i mchan 'grel thog spyod 'jug zhib khrid dang / li dge las phyi ma rgyud kyi khrid/ bla rgan pad bkra'i mdun nas kun mkhyen chos kyi 'byung gnas kyis mdzad pa'i phyag chen smon lam gyi 'grel ba bcas kyi lung gsan/ de nas sprul sku thugs sras mchog nas/ 'dzi sgar bshad grwar 'dzugs gnang skabs der bzhugs te lo gsum ring mkhan po chos mchog mdun nas/ dbu ma'i gzhung bzhi/ sdom gsum/sher phyin/ rgyud bla/ 'byed rnam gnyis bcas kyi khrid dang /kun bzang bla ma'i zhal lung / thar mdo/ bshags rgyud/11

'jam pal 4sna ba nyi mi'i mdza mthogs med spyod 'grel bcas kyi lung gsan/ zur mang 'brug pa sprul sku 'dzi sgar du zhabs sor bkod tshe/ sor mdo/ bskyed rdzogs gnad bsdus/ blo sbyong don bdun ma bcas kyi khrid gsan/ bskyed rdzogs gnad bsdus kyi bka' khrid gnang skabs shig tu/ sku mdun tshang nas mkhan rin po che gang sar she bun sogs kyi rtsis khra tho 'god par btang bas/ sprul sku thugs sras mchog thugs ma rang nas/mkhan rin po che la rang dbang med par mkhyen mod/ thabs gzhan med pas sku mdun du bos te/ khyed rang nas dgongs zhus mang po 'di bzhin bgyis tshe/ bshad grwa'i sgrig gshig 'gro bar 'dug pas/ bshad grwa nas phyir 'then gyis la/chad las su sgar gzhung gi tshogs su nyin gsum phyag 'tshol gsungs/ de bzhin bgyis pas/ 'brug pa sprul skus chos thun sar/ ban chung de la yag po zhig 'ong bar 'dug de gang du song / gsungs pas/ grwa rog zhig nas ji bzhin zhus/12

'jam pal 4te ba nyi mi'i mdza masprul sku rin po che nyid nas sku mdun tshang la bka' slob dang / thugs sras rin po che la dgongs sel gyis bshad grwar bzhugs chog par byung / bar mtshams rnams su 'brug sras rin po che'i mdun nas/ kun mkhyen pad dkar gyi gsung 'bum pod chen bcu dang / bla sgrub yig rnying / rten 'brel yig rnying / bsre 'pho yig rnying / snyan rgyud yig rnying /gling ras gsung 'bum pod gnyis/ rgya ras gsung 'bum pod gcig snyan rgyud yig gsar pod gcig lha rtse ba'i gsung 'bum pod gcig mkhas dbang sangs rgyas rdo rje'i gsung 'bum pod drug phyag chen rgya gzhung pod gsum bcas kyi ljags lung legs par gsan /pad grags mdun nas/ kun gzigs chos snang gi gsung 'bum pod bzhi/ rdor grags dgongs gter pod gciga'ajam mgon kong sprul gyis mdzad pa'i smyung gnas skor/kam tshang chos drug bcas kyi ljags lung gsan/13

'jam pal bsna ba nyi mi'i mdza mnyag bla mkhan po mkhas grub mdun nas/ nges shes sgron me/chos dbyings mdzod/ ye shes bla ma bcas kyi khrid gsan to/ /ji tsam gshis rgyud chos dang 'dres gyur tshe/ /de tsam chos tshul len la spro ba 'dis/ /tshigs bcad gcig gi phyir du sku lus kyang / /gtong ba'i gnas la goms pa cis mi 'gyur/ /dgung grangs nyer brgyad la phebs dus/ skyo brag mkhan po mi 'gyur 'dzi sgar bshad grwa'i mkhan por phebs dus/ sku mdun nas sum rtags/ snyan ngag le'u bar pa/rgya dang bod kyi sa dpyad/ spyod 'dug mngon pa gong 'ogasher phyin/ 'byed gnyis/ dbu ma 'jug pa/ zab mo nang don bcas kyi khrid gsan/ kar gling bar do/ zhi khro skor cha tshang / byams chos sde lnga bcas kyi lung gsan/ de dus mngon pa khrid gzhung du/ mkhan rin po che grwa phan bde dang lhan du 'jo mdar nas bun bsdu bar 'gro dgos pa'i 14

'jam pal 4pha ba nyi mi'i mdza mabaka' phebs kyis bshad grwa'i tshogs su zhugs ma thub/mkhan po mi 'gyur mchog nas/ bzhugs mal stong par gzigs 'phral/ 'dir bzhugs pa'i grwa pa gang du song gsungs pas/ sku mdun tshang nas 'jo mdar btang song zhes zhus tshe/ gsol dkar nang gi gsol ja de me rwa'i nang du thal 'tshub phyur re phyung / har gyis bzhengs te phebs grabs mdzad pas/ sku tshe sprul sku bde dga' nas mkhan po'i phyag nas bzung ste zhu ba yang yang phul/ mkhan po nam yang sku mdun khar phebs te/ gnas tshul ji bzhin zhus pas/mkhan rin po che 'jo mdar phebs dgos ma byung / de lta bus yongs 'dzin dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams kyis thugs nan chen pos rjes su bzung ba ni/bstan pa dang sems can gyi don rlabs po mdzad pa'i skyes bu dam pa 'di bzhin du gzigs par mngon no/ /zas gos nor gyis ji tsam dbul na yang / /dad brtson 15

'jam pal 4sna ba nyi mi'i mdza mashes pas phyug pa'i ded dpon mchog /mtha' yas chos tshul rgya mtsho'i mjing brgal ba'i/ /rnam dpyod rlung gi gru la slar yang ṭa/gas/ / dgung grangs nyer dgu bzhes tshe/ mkhan dam pa karma tshe brtan 'dzi sgar bshad grwar gdan zhus skabs/ gsang snying phyogs bcu mun sel/ kong sprul 'grel ba'i thog nas rgyud rgyal brtag pa gnyis pa dang / zab mo nang don bcas kyi rgyud bshad gsan/ byams chos sde lnga/ dbu ma rtsa 'jug bzhi gsum/ /bu lu dmar khrid/ tshig gsum gnad rdeg bde gshegs stong thun/ dbu ma rgyan bcas kyi zhib khrid gsan/ rnam shes ye shes dang snying po bstan pa gnyis kyi rtsa ba/ phyag rdzogs dbu gsum gyi smon lam/ bde chen zhing sgrub skor bcas kyi lung gsan/gser ljongs mkhan po dri med gdan zhus skabs/ dbu ma 'jug pa/ sor mdo/ 'byed rnam gnyis/ 'jam dpal 16

'jam pal 4te ba nyi mi'i mdza mamatshan brdzod/ chos dbyings mdzod/ sdom gsum rab dbye bcas kyi khrid gsan/ de dag gi bar skabs shig tu/ rgyal sprul rin po che'i sku mdun nas/ gdams ngag mdzod pod chen bcu'i dbang lung yongs rdzogs zhib rgyas su gsan/gsang ba snying po dang / mar mi dwags gsum gyi bla sgrub kyi dbang / tshig don mdzod dang / gnas lugs mdzod kyi lung bcas gsan/dam pa'i chos kyi dga' ba nang gi ro/ /yongs su brtas pa'i dgyes zhal nya rgyas zla/ /phyogs med thos bsam 'o ma'i rgya mtsho las/ /mngon gsal thub bstan gling bzhi'i rgyan du lī5gsi))da༄dgra'isasgur+ṣa m+muzhulhag twa rāsdesarkisdesi )r+yā ma sangs rgyas phrin las mchog dang lhan du/ 'tsho ba bsod snyoms la brten nas/ yul rdza stod kyi phyogs su phebs/ba thul thub dga' rin po che'i mdun nas/ 'dul ba mdo rtsa dang / rang zom pa'i snang ba lha sgrub kyi khrid gsan/17

'jam pal ོ ba nyi mi'i mdza mamakhan rta mgrin mdun nas/ mngon pa mdzod kyi khrid gsan/bod sprul mdun nas/ nyid kyis mdzad pa'i sher phyin 'grel ba dang / mi pham gsung dbu ma rgyan 'grel/ gsang snying spyi don 'od gsal snying po bcas kyi dpe khrid gsan/dpal yul mkhan po dkon mchog mdun nas/ mi pham sher 'grel ke ta ka'i khrid gsan/ blo gsal gzhon nu thu bo mchog las skar rtsis lnga bsdus/ gza' lnga/ dbyangs 'char bcas bslabs/ o rgyan dbang drag mdun nas/ ka ri ka lnga bcu pa dang / sum brgya pa gnyis kyi khrid gsan/ dpal sprul rdo 'bum la nyin gcig la lan bcu bskor ba mdzad ces gsung ngo / /phyogs ris gdon gyis myos pa'i sdang zug gis/ /zhing mchog dam pas rang rgyud brlag pa las/ /phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba mchod dang mi gnyis pa'i/ /dpal ldan bla ma gtsug tu cis mi bsten/ /de nas skye rgu dgon du phebs/ mkhan 18

'jam pa'/ 4te ba nyi mi'i mdza margan ngag dga' rin po che'i mdun nas/ mngon pa mdzod/dbu ma rtsa sher/ rtsod bzlog zhib mo rnam 'thag blo sbyong don bdun ma/ blo sbyong zhen pa bzhi bral bcas kyi khrid garnganan/ ban chen sangs rgyas mnyen pa'i mdun nas/ 'jam dpal bstod sgrub gsan/de nas rim gyis 'dzi sgar du zhabs sor bkod/ /dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi snying rje'i mdangs/ /'gro khams dge ba'i yid mtsho las 'khrungs pa'i/ /sum ldan yid bzhin 'byung ba'i nor bu mchog /spyi gtsug mngon par mtho ba'i rgyan du mdzes/ /lha mchog rdo rje'i sku 'bor du shar phyogs su phyin/ lha ma'i rnam 'dren rgyal ba thams cad mkhyen pa'i gser zhal mjal/ blo ldog rnam bzhi dang / spyan ras gzigs po bstod bcas kyi ljags lung bka' drin bstsal/karma pa rang byung rig pa'i rdo rje'i zhal snga nas/ byang chub 19

'jam pal 4te ba nyi mi'i mdza masems sdom/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho dang / bsam pa lhun grub kyi dbang lung legs par thob bo/ /gnyis pa ni/ thos bsam bsgoms pa las byung zhi ba'i sku/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i khri la legs 'dzegs te/ /mkhyen brtse nus pas gang 'dul chos kyi char/ /skal ldan gdul bya'i zhing sar ci yang phabs/ /de nas dgon pa'i bka' ltar 'dzi sgar dgon gyi mkhan po lo bzhir mdzad/ sdom gsum/spyod 'jug dbu ma 'jug pa sogs kyi zhib khrid bka' drin gnang / dgun bar zhig gi tshe/ lha mchog rdo rje'i sku 'khor tu khams gyi gnas mchog gtsang shis rdo rje gro lod du zhabs sor bkod de/ dgongs gter tshe sgrub skor gyi yi ge pa mdzad/ nyin mtshan sbrel bas zhi khro'i tshogs 'bum ther bsags/ yang bar skabs shig tu ra mgo dgon du phebs te/ brag g.yab mkhan po blo gros las/ dbu ma 'jug pa'i khrid 20

'jam pal 4tshe ba nyi mi'i mdza mgasan/ rdo rje'i mched po a bstan rgya mtsho'i mdun nas/thar rgyan/ phyag chen zla zer/ 'ba' ra ba'i ri chos/ rtse le'i bar do'i khrid/ 'od dpag skor tshang ma/ mal gcod bcas kyi lung gsan/ mched po dam pa dge sbyong las/ sngags kyi spyi don nor bu'i 'od zer dang / rnam shes ye shes dang snying po bstan pa gnyis kyi 'grel ba bcas kyi lung gsan/ khro ru mkhan po tshe rnam mdun nas/ snyan dngags le'u tha ma'i khrid gsan/ bla rgan chos blo mdun nas/ nag rtsis nyer bum gyi lag khrid dang / dbyar gnas 'don cha yongs rdzogs/ pad dz+rar/ tshe dpag zhi ba lha mang bcas kyi lung gsan/ 'dzi sgar rin po che lha mchog rdo rje'i sku mdun nas/nye sras cho ga'i lung gsan/ gar dbang rin che'i mdun nas/rgyud brtag gnyis rtsa ba dang / rdo rje theg spu'i smon lam bcas kyi lung gsan/ si tu pad+ma dbang mchog mdun nas/sbyan ras gzigs 'khor ba dong sprug gi dbang bzhes/ zung 21

'jam pal 4te ba nyi mi'i mdza mamang drung pa'i mdun nas/ spyan ras gzigs kyi rjes gnang bzhes/ grub chen karma nor bu'i mdun nas/ karma pa rang byung rdo rjes mdzad pa'i chos dbyings bstod pa'i 'grel ba'i lung gsan/ 'brug sras rin po che'i sku mdun nas/ lha rdor zhi khro'i dbang lung zhib rgyas dang / lha mchog rdo rje nyid kyi sku mdun nas/ tshe sgrub dang / brtan ma/ gcod/ zhal gdams dang smon lam skor bcas kyi lung legs par gsan bzhes gnang /bstan 'dzin nyin byed dbang po nub rir 'phags/ /log pa'i dpung gi mun tshogs ches cher rdol/ /bdud tshig 'byung bya'i skad ngan sgrogs dus 'dir/ /dam pa'i chos kyi sgron me lhag par gsal/ /phyi lo 1958 lor/ dus kyi 'tshub 'gyur shin tu che ba'i skabs su/ bshad grwa ba nyung shas shig la/ spyod 'jug gi khrid dang / dkyil 'khor khag gi thig ma31na bslabs gnang mdzad/22

'jam pal 4sna ba nyi mi'i mdza mas phag lo'i dpyid ka dus rim du/ dung sgrub 'tshogs sar skye bo mang por theg chen gso sbyong gi sdom pa gnang / da ni mtha' dmag gis bstan zhabs bsdu la nye ba yin pas/de dus sku srog shor ba sogs byung na/ nye bar mkho bas 'pho lung sbyang dgos gsungs te/ bag yod can gyi grwa pa rnams la 'pho lung gi dmigs rim zhib khrid bka' drin gnang ste/lhan du bsgoms pas kun la byang ba'i rtags thon par mdzad do/ /nyams chung srog la gzan te ri dwags bzhin/ /brtse med mtshon cha thogs pas 'ded pa'i tshe/ /legs nyes lam la blo gros mig bgrad nas/ /mi dge'i g.yang las dang por thar par mdzad/ /dpyid zla 'bring po'i mthar karma dgon gyi nye 'dabs su/ bla ma dpal dga' dang lhan du/ lha mchog rdo rje'i mkha' 'gro bsu bar phebs/ de tshe bod zla gsum pa'i tshes bcu'i nyin/ skya ser mang po mtshon 'og tu song 23

'jam pal ོ ba nyi mi'i mdza mnas dgon par dmag gis bzung ba'i gtam thos pas/ri dwags rmas ma ltar/ gtad med kyis ri sul dang lung stong brgyud/ nyin mtshan rer sdod gnas bdun brgyad tsam spos te/ 'jigs skrag gi ngang du gnas/ re zhig nas bla ma dpal dga' dang mkha' 'gro bcas/ lha mchog rdo rje'i sku mdun du phebs thub pa'i gta ma gsan/ mkhan rin po che sogs ser skya pho mo rgan byis dang bcas pa nyis brgya lhag tsam bar do'i sems can ltar 'jigs shing skrag pas ri sul du gnas/ der yod mi che ba rnams kyis ni/ khyi rgan gad la thug pa'i dpe ltar/ rgya dmag dang 'thab pa'i bya ba kho na brtsams/ mkhan rin po che nas/ bla ma a brtan rgya mtsho dang / mkhan po a sangs sogs grwa pa bdun la/dmag dpung lhos chen 'di 'dra ba dang 'thab pas rgyal kha mi thub pa gtan khel/ srog la'ang nyan kha yod pa ma zad/phar la rgya dmag re gnyis bsad tshe/ dmag la sogs pa 24

'jam pal 4te ba nyi mi'i mdza mdon gcig phyir/ /thams cad byed pa po bzhin ldan/ /ces bya bas/ tshangs par spyod pa la bar chad 'byung bar shin tu nye/ de bas na sprang 'khyam gyis/ rab na phyi rgyal du slebs thub pa/ ma byung na'ang nyes skyon de dag las gzur thub pa zhig 'byung bas/ zur du bros na legs shes gsungs/de ltar kha phor dang / rtsam khug yang med par bros lam la phebs/ lto slong bzhin brag g.yab brgyud/ wa kho nas tshugs lam brgyud de phebs/ lha ri mgo nas phu ded kyis 'bri gung dang / rā sgreng gi 'a brog par bsod snyoms mdzad bzhin phebs pas rgya dmag dang phrad/ zhag shas do dam nan po byas rjes/ nor dang mtshon cha sogs gang yang med cing /rtsad 'dri byung rigs la dogs gnas ma byung nas/ lha sar phebs lam gyi 'dzin zhig bcas gtong / lha sar zhabs sor 'bod/ jo bo rin po che yang yang mjal res bzhin bstan pa dang 'gro ba'i don du thugs smon gang zab gnang /25

'jam pal ོ ba nyi mi'i mdza ma'atsho ba slong mos bskyal bas rgya mis lta stangs ha cang ngan pa byas/ rgyud smad par spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi slob gso zla ba gnyis mthar/ grwa bzhi ngar lcags bzo grwa 'bras spungs gyad lung khrang / rnga chen chu slog las grwa se ra dgon sogs su/ mu ge'i 'tsho ba la brten nas ngal rtsol sha thang chad chad du byed dgos byung ngo / / bdag bas gces par 'dzin pa'i skye bo 'gas/ /nyes med dgra bzhin gnod pa byed na'ang / /byams pa'i sku la bzod pa'i go bgos pas/ /sems kyi dgra bos nam yang tshugs ma gyur/ /de nas chu stag lor khams su phyir log rgyu'i chog mchan thob/ lo 'jug tu 'dzi sgar du phebs/ phyi lor 'jigs skrag gi ngang du gnas/ shing 'brug lor slob gso chen po gsum gyi las 'gul zer ba spel/ nyes 'gel gyi zhwa mo brgya lhag tsam bskon/ sprang chas phran bu yod rigs phrog ste/ 'dzi sgar du 'dzin bzung byas/ 'dzi sgar chus 26

'jam pal 4te ba nyi mi'i mdza ma'og gi shang khag bzhi'i mi grangs nyis brgya lhag bsdus te/brdung rdeg dang bcas 'thab rtsod drag po nyin bzhi bcu lhag tsam byas/ de dus skye bo 'ga' res da tsam mkhan rin po che dgongs pa gzhan du gshegs thub na zhes gleng ba'i tshod tsam pa'i 'o rgyal bzhes/ de nas rkang lcags dang bcas 'jo mda'i btson khang du zla ba bdun bzhugs dgos byung / de dus mang tshogs kyi re 'dun yin pa'i skad kyis srog thog tu gtong rgyu yin pa'i khrims bshad kho nar byas pas/ khang mig gcig pa'i btson rog dmar yon bkra rdor sogs gzhan drug po rnams la 'chi khar bsam pa ngan pa dran mi nyan pa'i tshul dang /dkon mchog la blo ling gis 'gel dgos tshul sogs 'jigs pa dang dogs pa spangs te ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i gsung gi dbugs dbyung chen po'i bka' drin lan mang du bstsal ba der yod rnams kyis rjes su yang yang gleng ngo/ / 27

'jam pal 4tho ba nyi mi'i mdza ma'ajig rten rgud tshogs blo las rab 'gongs kyang / /dka' thub ro snyoms spyod pa'i thabs mkhas kyi/ grogs su khyer 'di zhi bde'i lam bzang du/ /bdag nyid chen po rnams kyi thugs su bstar/ /de nas shing sprul lor chab mdor rtsis sprod byas/ der do dom che shos yin pa'i rgya shog dang po'i nang lo gsum bzhugs/ nyin mtshan gnyis kar las byed pa dang bcas/ ma rtsa ring lugs kyi rtsam pa las spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi phub ma bza' bar dga' zhes pa lta bu'i slob sbyong dang gros bsdur byed dgos shing / bshad lugs sogs cung zad kho tsho'i blo la ma babs tshe brdung rdeg drag po byed pa sogs dka' tshegs shin tu che bar mchi/ de dus ltog grir shi ba mang zhing / cung zad bza' bca' rnyed tshe ltogs pa zas 'phrad kyis shi ba'ang yod/ de'ang nyin zhig btson pa zhig la khyim nas btson chas rgyu ma zhig 'byo ra song bas/ phyi nyin rgyu ma lhag 'phros de ske la phreng ba bzhin gyon 28

'jam pal thusto ba nyi mi'i mdza mnas shi ba dang / de min gzhan zhig la rtsam pa sgro chung gang 'byor byung bas/ de'ang phyi nyin sgro chung pang du bzhag lag pa gnyis kyis 'gyud de shi ba'i tshul gleng du yod 'dug pa de lta bu'i dus ngan shar ba'i tshe/ yid skyo dang 'brel bas bzang spyod dang / sgrol ma sogs yid bzlas ci nus byas gan+da/ngas/me lug lo'i dgun khar/ sngar 'jo mda' nas g.yog pa'i rdzun zhwa de dag gzhir bzhag gis khrims gcod 31 lngar byas pa'i yi ge 'byor/ de dus chab mdor btson khang khag bzhi yod pa las/ g.yi mda' dang 'dzi thang gnyis kyi btson khang gi btson pa rnams kyis lo thog 'debs las dang /gca' ka'i phu la yod pa rnams kyis shing gcod pa dang so ba bzo dgos/ sil thog thang gi btson pas khang las dang sngo tshal 'debs las byed dgos pas/ mkhan rin po che sil thog thang du bzhugs dgos byung / ngal las sna tshogs bya 29

'jam pal 4tho ba nyi mi'i mdza mabazhin lo ke kho zhes pa der lo gsum song / khyon bsdoms btson khang du lo drug bzhugs/ lo ltar dgun kha'i slob sbyong zhes nyes 'dzugs kyi las 'gul spel te/ btson pa 'ga' re srog thog gtong ba dang / 'thab rtsod brdung brdeg sogs kyis gzhin rje'i 'jig rten mig sngar mngon sum du 'char ba bzhin byed/ de nas lcags khyi 61ra las zhugs pa zhes pa'i khongs su bzhag de ni dgongs zhus dang 'brel bas phyi log tu phebs chog tsam las gzhan snga ma dang cha 'dra ba yin/ der lo bcur bzhugs/ de'i ring mkhan rin po che nyid las zhugs pa'i dngul spro bsdu dang / 'tsho ba nyo bsgrub bya mkhan mdzad/de dus chos kyi bya ba gzhan bgyi dbang med pas las 'bras la sems pa'i yid kyi dge ba cung zad byas par sems shes gsungs so/ /ji snyed blo yi 'jug pa dge tshogs su/ /rnam par dag pas 30

'jam pal 4tho ba nyi mi'i mdza ma ngang gis lus dang ngag /g.yo ba tsam yang phan bde'i rgyu ra 'gyur mod/ /legs tshogs mtha' dag sdud 'di 'dod chen min/ lcags sprel lor glod grol thob/ jo bo rin po che mjal du lha sar phebs/ phyag mchod gsol smon sogs gang zab gnang / sku gsung thugs rten gzhan phal cher bshig gtor byas rjes gsar bzo bya bzhin pa las/ phal pa rnams la dang ba 'dren nus pa de 'dra zhig byung mi 'dug ba/blo/nga'asdo/de nas lo shas ring 'tsho ba bsod snyoms kyis/ dgon pa'i 'don chog gi skor dang / gzhung chen mo'i rtsa ba sogs nyer mkho'i dpe sna tshogs pod bco lnga tsam/ sku nyid gcig pus zhu dag dang 'brel/ dad can rnams la yon sbyor rgyu'i bskul ma dang / par yon sprod len gyi sku las gnang / lder tsho'i lha de dag rgan dge dpal lags nas gsar bzhengs gnang skabs/ gzungs bzhugs yongs rdzogs dpar 31

'jam pal ོ ba nyi mi'i mdza malas dang / bsgril rgyur sogs la phyag ro gas mi gcig dang /gsol chas thengs gcig gi bkod sgrig med kyang / sla chos sogs bor te tshul bzhin pa'i phyag las mdzad/sha khrag btsir ba'i dngos rdzas mer bsregs shing / /rngul nag thig pa'i 'du khang rdzas mes gtor/ /'dus pa'i sde tshogs bsad bzung gis bcom yang / /las 'bras 'khor phyogs su yis zlog par nus/ /nam zhig dpyid kyi rdul rlung g.yo ba'i khrod/ /gog po'i gyang ral rta rna la 'gran pas/ /rab dkar gur thag 'then pa'i skyo ba dang / /mkhar bas rten pa'i lam kha'i bgres song 'gas/ /'dzum pa'i bzhin gyis snyan pa'i gsung dbyangs las/ /'dus sde gsar pa'i dga' ston mjal lo zhes/ /sgrogs pa'i gtam las dga' ba 'di yang 'gran/ /bgrang bya rab tu smin pa'i 'dus tshogs dbus/ /dbu skyes gur gyi mdangs dang mi gnyis yang / /zhi dang dul bas gzi byin mtshungs med pa'i/ /32

'jam pal sgordzo ba nyi mi'i mdza mdagyes zhal mjal ba'i skal bzang kho bos reg /de tshe 'dren pa mchog 'dis khrims ldan gyi/ /dge 'dun tshogs rnams bshad dang bsgrub pa la/ /'du bar bskul gsung dbyangs chos kyi dung / /'dus tshogs mdzes pa'i rgyan du ci yang sgrogs/ /shing glang lor 'dzi sgar dgon pa bskyar gso'i chog mchan thob/ lha khang dang / 'tshogs rten sogs la 'bad pa gnang / de dus gus pa 'dzi sgar du lo gsum ma zin tsam bsdad/ mkhan rin po che tshogs pa'i nang dang lam bar du thengs ma kha shas mjal/ sku gzugs thung tsam la sku mdog sprug zhad chags pa/ dbu skra dkar po can/ phebs lam du lhod pos thad kar gzigs te sgra chung ngus skyabs 'gro gsung bzhin 'byon pa zhig mthong /brtse chen thugs kyis bzung ba'i 'gro ba la/ /ma bskul lha yi rnga bzhin chos kyi sgras/ /rgyal bstan nyi ma myur du 'char 33

'jam pal ོ ba nyi mi'i mdza maro zhes/ /dam pa'i gsung gis dbugs dbyung ci yang mdzad/ /tshogs su skyabs tho gsungs zhor gtam dpe dang sbrag grwa pa'i tshugs dang / 'don chog ji ltar dag par bya tshul sogs bka' slob thengs kha shas gnang song / tshig gi sgros gtsang zhing gsung skad yid la sim pa zhig snang / de dus tsa na cha rgyus yod pa rnams kyis dad gus bya yul tsam las/ sngar gnas 'dir dge 'dun gyi nang khrims shin tu gtsang zhing / tshogs 'gro sgrig 'don/ gar 'cham dbyangs rol sogs legs po yod skad 'dug kyang / bar skabs su gsung chos gnang ba sogs ye ma dar ba'i dbang gis bka' chos zhu shes mkhan sogs nyung / de skabs su dgu chung zhig gi tshe/ mkhan rin po che rkang gling 'bud mkhan dang / bla ma a sangs mchog nas rnga brdung gnang mdzad/bsnyen mtshams sogs ma song ba'i mchod dpon zhig gis/sngar lugs su sems te/ rdor slob kyi bya ba rnams byed par 34

'jam pal slotho ba nyi mi'i mdza mamathong / 'on te ya mtshan gang yang skye ma shes so/ /mtshan nyid yongs rdzogs bshes gnyen dam pa yi/ /'dod rgu kun 'byung dpag bsam ljon pa'i 'gram/ /bag med gnas rnams nam zhig longs spyod pa'i/ /skal bzang bral tshe shes kyang rtas mi zin/ /de dus mkhan mkhan rin po che'i mtshan du a dge zhes 'bod/ dgung na rgan rbesgos su byed pa'i ban rgan don brgyud nas/ mkhas btsun bzang gsum gang gi phyogs nas kyang a dge 'dra ba dgon 'dir sngar yang byon yod tshod ma red la/ phyis kyang 'byon 'ong bsam pa med/ ces gsungs par thos rgan 'jam chos nas kyang / a dge mi yi g.yang red/ nor bu red/ nga dang chung dus nas 'dris yod/ rta rmig lcags kyis gtum nas brtsal kyang 'di 'dra'i bla ma rnyed rgyu yod ma red/ ces gsungs pa sogs cha rgyus yod pa'i rgan rabs shes yon can rnams kyi ngag las rgyun par thos na'ang / de 35

'jam pal 4te ba nyi mi'i mdza mdus sku mdun du bcar rgyu ma byung ba ni/ yul dus kyi 'du shes ngan pa'i dbang du song bas te/ gcig ni/ bsten bya bla ma la mtshan nyid ji lta bu zhig dgos par mi shes pa'i dbang gis/ bla mas rang nyid la blang dor gyi gnas ston pa de rang nyid kyis shes par byas te dge sdig 'dor len byed dgos pa'i bsam pa tsam yang med par/ sku chen du grags pa zhig gis/ mi 'dod pa thams cad sel ba dang / 'dod pa thams cad ster bar sems te/ de'i rjes su g.yam rgyug byed pa'i srol lugs shig yod pa 'di dang / gnyis su ni/ chos sna gcig thos na dge rtsa dang yon tan sna re skye zhing / skyon dang nyes pa sna re zad pa ma zad/ bag chags bzang po 'jog pa sogs gang yang go ma myong bas/ thos bsam slob gnyer gnang ba de tshe 'dir mkhan po zhig ma gyur na don med pa lta bur sems/ gsum du ni/ rab tu byung ba de klog spang gi ched du yin bsam pa yid kyi rgu na med pas/ grwa pa rgas 36

'jam pal 4sna ba nyi mi'i mdza mthub dgos/ shi thub dgos shes 'don te/ tshul khrims kyi zhing du thos bsam bsgom pa'i lo tog gang yang med na'ang /dal ba'i rten 'di 'bor ba'i skyon gyis 'joms che legs par sems pa sogs 'du shes phyin ci log gi tshang rdol ba de dag gi dbang du song bas so/ /me yos lor 'dzi sgar dgon du gnam chos pod bcu gsum gyi ljags lung bka' drin stsal/khyod kyis ji snyed chos tshul rgya mtsho las/ /dka' bas drangs pa'i bshad dang sgrub pa'i rgyun/ /bstan dang 'gro la dmigasapa'i lhag bsam gyis/ /skal ldan gdul bya'i zhing sar ci yang 'dren/ /sa 'brug lor/ lci sprul mchog dang zhal mthun gyis/ bshad grwa bskyar 'dzugs gnang / de dus phran bshad grwar zhugs rgyu'i skal bzang byung / mkhan rin po che zhogs snga bar bzhengs te zhal phyag bkru mchod pa bshams/zhogs pa'i chos spyod rnams gsungs/ chu tshod brgyad pa nas 37

'jam pal 4sna ba nyi mi'i mdza mabashad grwar phebs te chos rim tshar rjes blo gros rgya mtshos zhus pa'i mdo las gsungs pa'i bdud rnams tshar gcod pa'i sngags sngon du song bas/ kun slong byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed par bskul te/ gzhung gang yin gyi 'chad thabs dang / sa bcad gang gi khongs su bshad pa skabs su babs pa gsungs nas gzhung bshad dngos la 'jugatshig dag cing sgra gsal bas dang po dal pos rgyas bshad tshar gcig dang / de nas yang bskyar de las bsdus tsam tshar gcig gsungs gnang mdzad/ bka' mol sogs gzhan gyi tshe na'ang byung rgyal du smra ba dang / gtam nyob po de 'dra rtsa ba nas gsung srol med/ de bzhin du chos 'chad tshul la'ang / gcod mtshams legs shing dpe dang bcas pas go bde ba ma zad/ bar bar du don gyi gnad bsdus te gsungs pas nyan pa po'i yid la 'dzin bde ba/ bla ma rnams kyi gsung sgros dang / mdo sogs las byung ba'i 38

'jam pal ོ ba nyi mi'i mdza mgatam rgyud dang sbyor tshe 'brel chags shing rmugs pa sangs nus pa/ don gyi snying po bsgrub pa nyams len la gzhol bas gnad du 'gro ba sogs man ngag gi gter rdol ba lta bur 'chad/ chu tshod bcu dang phyed tsam nas dpe khrid grub pa dang chab bsil grol/ de nas dpe rgyug len/ gsol ja 'dren tshar ba dang mtshams 'jog ste/ ja gsol zhor sngar nyin blor 'dzin rgyur bzhag rigs rgyug len grub pa dang / lung tshig gal che rigs sho lo ka gsum bzhi re tsam blo la ma zin gyi bar du zhal slob mdzad/ de nas rang rang gis dpe klog gang mtshams bya/ chu tshod bcu gnyis nas tshul khrims rab bsngags gsungs te gung tshigs grol/chu tshod gnyis pa nas skyor dpon gyis tshar gcig gsungs rjes/ rang rang gi dpe klog byed bzhin go dka' rigs mkhan rin po che la bka' 'dri dogs sel zhu/ mi gcig gis zhus pa'i dogs gnas la gsungs pa'i lan gzhan 39

'jam pal slotho ba nyi mi'i mdza marnams kyis kyang nyan nas so sos gang 'dod 'dod dri/ chu tshod drug pa nas gzhung chen mo'i rtsa ba dum bu gcig dang gtor bsngos bsdus tsam gsungs nas gzims shag tu phebs/ lam bar du mi gzhan dag dang 'phrad tshe khams bde'i 'tshams 'dri tsam las bka' mol sogs ye mi gsungs/ lam du 'byon bzhud sogs kyi skabs su rgyun par tshul khrims kyi dri bsung ldang / shag tu mchod ting rnams dang po thal ba 'jam pos thengs re dang / bal ras sogs 'jam pos thengs re phyi ba sogs mchod pa shin tu ngos gtsang bar mdzad/ de nas gtong len bsgom pa sogs dgong ka'i chos spyod la 'jug de lta bu'i nyin gcig pa nas nyin gcig pa'i 'gros ltar mdzad/ dbyar dgun gyi chos mtshams skabs ma gtogs mal gso sogs mi 'jogabashad grwa ba rnams lo rer thar chog thengs re 'dug srol yod pas de'i phyi nyin yang dpe khrid sogs sngar ltar gnang /40

'jam pal 4tshe ba nyi mi'i mdza mthengs shig rkang 'bam gyi snyung gzhi shin tu lci ba zhig bzhes skabs gzims shag tu dpe khrid sogs chad med gsungs/grong chog tu phebs pa lta ci dgos dbang shin tu che na ma gtogs dgon pa gzhan dag gis gdan drangs pa'ang dka' ste/ me glang lor 'jo phu dgon du bshad grwa tshugs skabs/ phran gyis bsam par/ mkhan rin po ches dbu 'dzugs shig gnang grub na phyin chad 'gal rkyen bar chad mi 'byung ba'i dgos par bsam ste/ sku bcar gyis phebs grub rgyur nan zhus byas kyang / nga 'gro dgos ma red/gza' skar sogs kyang ma rgug chos 'chad nyan tshig gcig yin na'ang bar chad du ma gtong / mgyogs par gyis gsungs te zhal bzhes ma thob/ de bzhin du lha mthong 'dre 'dul sogs kyi mdzad pa mi skyong bas don chung gis brel zing 'di'ang nyung / sku chen gyi rnam pa'i dri tsam yang mi mnga' bas bka' chos sogs ni/ nyin ma gtogs mtshan zhus 41

'jam pal slordzo ba nyi mi'i mdza mna'ang sku nga'/ sogs kyis 'tsher snang mi dgos/ de'ang skye bo bsod nams chos dar la skar rtsis lnga bsdus bslabs pa dang / sman pa lta bu 'ga' la dgong zhog gi dus la spyod 'jug bshes spring / de min bslab bya sogs kyid khrid ci'ang gnang ba dang / shing phag lo'i dgun shin tu grang ba'i sgang du/ rtsa rgyud brtag gnyis 'jam mgon kong sprul gyi 'grel ba'i thog nas/ khrid gzhung du ke re gong pa'i grwa pa gnyis phebs byung ma gtogs/ phran gcig pu la bka' drin gnang ba lta bu'o/ /de lta bu'i mdzad pa lhur bzhes pas/ khor yug tu chos gsungs pa la bar chad gang yang med/ spyod pa shin tu zhib cing dman sa bzung ba la tshod med pas nang gi rtogs pa'i yon tan rnams shin tu sbas pa ni/ dper na/ phran gyis mdzad rnam gyi skor cung zad cig bka' drin zhus pa'i lan du/gsung bris bstsal ba las/ chos dang mthun pa'i rigs cung 42

'jam pal 4tho ba nyi mi'i mdza mazad re yod pa rnams phyung ste/ gzhan bya spyod dang bsam blo tshang ma/ dug gsum gyis kun nas bslang zhing / 'jig rten chos brgyad kyi rang bzhin kho na las ma 'das pas/ yi ger 'bri mi 'o sa pa smos ci dgos lags/ zhes bskur gnang ba lta bu'o/ /'dod chung chog shes can ni/ chos chos su song ba'i rtags yin gsungs te/ thugs dgyes shos su byed/dge 'dun gyi sde ni cis kyang dam chos 'dul ba dang mthun dgos gsungs/ skra dang gos sogs la shin tu nan tan mdzad/ dper mtshon na/ phran la skra ring ba'i snang ba ye ma byung nas bzhar rgyu ma byung bas/ nyin zhig tshogs pa'i nang du skra bzhar spyad cig phyag tu bsnams nas/ 'di dge legs dang dpal 'chi gnyis la sprad rogs/ gsungs te mar gnang byung / de tsam ni zhal snga nas kyi mdzad pa la ltos na gnas 'di la shin tu gal chen du brtsi ba'i tshul du bsam nas/ de rjes shin tu gzab dgos par gyur/ mkhan 'chi 43

'jam pal ོ ba nyi mi'i mdza mamed nas/ a dge lags/ lwa ba'i sham thab kha dog smyag po byed srol 'di ji lta bus byung ba lags/ shes zhus pas/'o de/ gos ngan re thul gyon pa'i dus/ shes bya ba lta bus dus ngan gyi rtags yin gsungs/ de lta bus rtags dang cha lugs tshun chad legs par gdam/ nga tshos dge tshul slong dang rigs lnga'i dbang bskur gnyis ka zhus kyang cha lugs 'di bzhin du spyod pa ni/ bstan pa spyi yangs kyi 'gros/yul dang dus/ lam khyer gyi nus pa sogs la ltos pas yin/ de ltar min pa'i smyo spyod kyis bstan pa sun 'byin/rang gzhan rogs gsum phung la sbyor ba sogs nyes che zhes skabs dang 'brel tshe nan cher gsungs/ mal gcod kyi par byang smon tshig tu'ang / smyo spyod tho co phal gyis 'gran bral ba/ /grub dbang rgyal mtshan dpal bzang mchog gi lung / /zhes bkod gnang mdzad/ sngar sku na gzhon pa'i dus su/ 'dzi sgar dgon du grub thob tu grags pa zhig 44

'jam pal 4te ba nyi mi'i mdza mgadan/ des rdor dril bar snang du 'jog pa sogs ngo mtshar du gleng ba'i mdzad pa mang po gnang skad 'dug pa de ji lta bu lags shes bka' 'dri zhus pas/ grwa rogs rnams kyis dngos su mthong zer/ yin na'ang nga khong mjal sar 'gro ma myong gsungs/ des na rnam 'grel las gsungs pa'i rigs pa de dag mdzad pas gdam par snang /gzhan yang / mkhan po bstan pa mchog nas/ sor sdom skabs bka' 'dri zhus pa'i lan dang / bsod rdor nas snyan ngag gi dper brjod phul tshul sogs ni/ chos grogs rnams bzhad gad kyis rgyu ma chad du dogs te ma bris so/ /brtse chen thugs kyi dmigs pa phyogs med ces/ /zhib tu bsam na smra bar rigs mod kyi/ /ji tsam 'grogs pas de tsam byams pa'i stobs/ /'phel bar 'gyur zhes ngag nas lan mang shor/ /mdor na ji tsam 'dris na de tsam gyis mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyi yon tan phyi phyir mthong ste 45

'jam pal 4sna ba nyi mi'i mdza mdaga' dad gus gsum gyi zhing du bzhugs shing / legs par brtag na/ bshes gnyen dul ba zhi ba nyer zhi ba/ /yon tan lhag pa brtson bcas lung gis phyug /de nyid rab tu rtogs la smra mkhas ldan/ /brtse ba'i bdag nyid skyo ba spangs la brten/ ces ji skad du gsungs pa'i gzhung 'di nyid kyis lung bstan pa lta bur bzhugs so/ /rgya chen gzhung mang brtsegs pa'i garnyo lar/ /gnas brtan nye bar 'khor dang mi gnyis pas/ /gzung spobs chos kyis brdung ba'i gaṇ+ḍi'i sgra/ /skal ldan rna ba'i dpyid du ci yang 'jo/ /'di dus bshad grwar dpe khrid dang lung gnang ba'i skor ni/dge tshul ka ri ka lnga bcu pa/ sor mdo/ mdo rtsa ba/ mngon mdzod/ kun btus/ dbu ma rtsa sher/ 'jug pa/ bzhi brgya pa/ spyod 'jug mdo sde rgyan/ 'byed rnam gnyis/ rgyud bla ma/ thar rgyan/ sdom gsum rnam nges/ bskyed rdzogs gnad 46

'jam pa05 4te ba nyi mi'i mdza mabasdus/ rgyal sras lag len/ lam mchog rin chen phreng ba/snyan ngag le'u bar mtha' gnyis bcas kyi zhib khrid bka' drin bstsal/ 'jam mgon rin pa'i thar chog gi skor / phyag chen do ha/ kong sprul bla ma rgyang 'bod/ gcod rin chen phreng ba/ chags med ri chos/ dpal sprul gyi sems khrid bsgom pa rang grol/ 'ba' ra ba'i mal gcod/ chos brgyad mgo snyom/ karma gling pa'i bar do'i chos skor / zur mang pad rnam gyis mdzad pa'i bskyed rdzogs gnad bsdus kyi 'grel ba/sna tshogs rang grol gyi bar do'i spyi don/ dwags po bkra rnam gyi phyag 'grel zla zer/ dge sbyor bdun ma'i smon lam/kun mkhyen gsung rnal 'byor bzhi'i bshad pa don dam mdzub tshugs/ nges don blta mig phyag chen bsdus pa'i zin bris/ phyag chen bshad bla/ dge sbyor bdun pa'i nyams len sgang bsgril/ rdzogs chen pad+ma snying thig sngon 'gro'i zin bris/ yang 'dzin 'jam dpal dpa' bo'i snyan rgyud 47

'jam pal 4tho ba nyi mi'i mdza malhan cig skyes ma'i snyan yig rdor grags kyi bdud 'dul drag po'i bsnyen yig dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu'i bskyed rim zin tho/ si tu bstan pa'i nyin byed kyi phyag chen smon lam 'grel ba/ 'bru 'jam grags kyi ro snyoms sgang bsgril gyi don khrid/ kun gzigs sngon 'gro thogs med spyod 'grel/ dri med bshags chen bka' ma/ snyan rgyud rdo rje'i tshig rkang mar pa'i 'gyur bcas lung gnang /lcags rta lo'i dgun kha'i chos mtshams tshe/ dpal chen dgon pas gdan zhus kyis/ phyi nang gi grwa btsun mang du 'dus pa la/ kun mkhyen bka' 'bum pod nyer bzhi'i ljags lung bka' drin gnang / lcags lug lor bshad grwa ba rnams la/ 'jam mgon kong sprul gsung bslab pa yongs sbyong gi gzhi dang / le tshan phyogs bsdus/ nyes sdom dag byed/ dbyar khas len/ zhib mo rnam gsal/ rung khang byin rlab/ mdo lugs sad srung /48

'jam pal 4te ba nyi mi'i mdza mkhyad par 'phags bstod/kha che pan chen gyi gsol 'debs/mchog gyur gling mgon po trag shad kyi gsol mchod/dwags po rin po che'i bka' 'bum/ grub thob gling gi gces bsdus sgron me/nges 'byung sgron me/ don gsal sgron me/dwags po bkras rnam pa'i phyag rgya chen po'i gnyug ma'i de nyidagasal byed/zhang tshal pa'i phyag chen dkar po chig thub/nā ro pa'i spyod pa chos glu yang dgon pa'i phyag chen/'jamadapal dpa' bo'i sngon 'gro ljags lung bstsal/rje nyid kyis/ kho bo la btson nas thar rjes bka' chos dbang lung 'tshol zhu bya ched gzhan du 'gro ba'i nus shugs ma mchis/ 'on te mos pa ma bor tsam du dbang lung khrid gsum cung zad re thob na snyam pa 'dug gsungs pa bzhin/stabs khel tshe gang thob mdzad de/waṃ dgon sprul sku bla rgan ngag chos mdun nas dri med rnam gnyis kyi dbang bskur bzhes/mchog sprul rin po che'i mdun nas/srol gnyis 49

'jam pal 4tho ba nyi mi'i mdza maso so las byung ba'i byang chub sems sdom dang / 'brug lugs bla ma mchod pa/ gnam chos 'od dpag dkon mchog spyi 'dus/ bde mchog lhan skyes bcas kyi dbang bskur/ ras chung lugs kyi grub rgyal tshe dbang / ye shes mgon po phyag bzhi pa dang / bya gdong / dud sol lha mo bcas kyi rjes gnang dang bcas bzhes/ ban rgan bshad sgrub rgya mtsho las dwags po'i gsung 'bum e waṃ gnyis dang /chags med bde smon 'grel ba sogs rtsib ri'i dpar ma pod bzhi tsam gyi lung gsan/rtag chad mthar lta'i g.yang la 'phyan sla yang / /zab cing rtogs dka' bder gshegs lam bzang nas/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i grong du dkri mdzad pa'i/ /yang dag lam gyi sa mkhan dge ba'i bshes/ /chu sprel lo nas bshad grwa ba lnga bcu skor zhig la/ snga ma ltar snyan ngag sor mdo dang mdo rtsa/ dbu ma'i gzhung bzhi/ mngon pa gong 'og byams chos 50

'jam pal 4te ba nyi mi'i mdza masde lnga/ sdom gsum/ thar rgyan/ zab mo nang don/ rgyud brtag gnyis bcas kyi zhib khrid bka' drin gnang / mkhan po dam chos zla ba sogs la zab mo nang don gyi khrid gnang /skyabs che sprul sku bkra shis nor bu la/ dgyes pa rdo rje'i rgyud bshad sogs bka' drin bstsal skabs/ sprul sku bkra shis nor bu las/ bka' brgyud sngags mdzod nang gi dgyes pa rdo rje'i dbang dang / karma'i mkhan chen gyi gsung 'bum pod gnyis kyi lung / gsol 'debs rdo rje 'chang thung ma'i khrid bcas gsan bzhes gnang /nyon mongs rtog tshogs nang gi chom rkun dang / /gdon bgegs log 'dren phyi yi dgra bo yis/ /nye zho med par tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa'i sar/ /skyel ma lta bu'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen mchog /me byi lo nas rje nyi da kyi zhal slob phrin las rdo rje mkhan khrir mnga' gsol zhus rjes 'dzi sgar bshad grwar lhan du gzigs te/ gzhung chen bcu gsum 51

'jam pal 4sna ba nyi mi'i mdza mayongs rdzogs dang / bshes spreng / dbu ma rgyan/ zab mo nang don bcas kyi zhib khrid gnang / mkhan phrin dga' mchog nas rigs lam 'phrul lde rtsod khrid mdzad skabs yongs rdzogs dang / dge tshul sum brgya pa/ sa lugs snang gsum bcas kyi khrid dang / 'dul ṭig nyi ma'i 'od zer/blo sbyong zhen pa bzhi bral/ rje rin po che'i lam gtso rnam gsum/ gzungs bsdus/ 'dul ba me tog phreng rgyud/khams pa'i phyag chen dngos gzhi'i khrid yig bcas kyi lung gsan/ khro ru mkhan po sogs la zab mo nang don dang /rgyud brtag gnyis sogs kyi khrid dang / ljongs gnas mkhan po rgya mtsho sogs la zab mo nang don gyi khrid bcas bka' drin ba45pa/mtha' dang zad du med pa'i sdug bsngal gyi/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtsho che las sgrol ba yi/ /dam pa'i chos kyi gru yi mnyan pa mchog /dge ba'i bzhes gnyen dam pa yongs kyi ma/gon/ /52

'jam pal 4tshe ba nyi mi'i mdza malcags 'brug lo nas 'dzi sgar bshad grwar/ sum brtagadage tshul lnga bcu pa/ sor mdo/ spyod 'jug sdom gsum/mdo sde rgyan/ dbu ma bzhi brgya pa/ thar rgyan/ bskyed rdzogs gnad bsdus/ bu lu dmar khrid/ blo sbyong don bdun ma bcas kyi zhib khrid bka' drin bstsal/'gro khams dge ba'i bsod nams rgya mtsho che/ /brtse chen nyi ma'i 'od dang 'grog pa las/ /smon lam rgyun mi 'chad pa'i sprin 'khrigs te/ /lhun grub chos kyi gru char ci yang 'jo/ /de nas dgung grangs don dgu la phebs/ spyan gyis gzigs dka' zhing zhabs cung mi bde ba sogs dang /slob tshogs rnams kyis phyin chad bstan pa 'dzin skyong gi 'gan bzhes pa'i slad du/ zhal slob mkhan po 'chi med nas bshad grwar gzigs rgyur mdzad de/ mkhan rin po che bshad grwa'i tshogs su phebs te chos 'chad rgyu re zhig bzhaga'on te gzims shag tu khrid lung man ngag sogs sngar 53

'jam pal 4te ba nyi mi'i mdza mabazhin gnang / gu phu dgon tshe sprul dpon slob rnams la/rgyud brtag gnyis dang / bskyed rdzogs gnad bsdus/bshes spring / karma rgyal mtshan sogs la/ mngon pa kun btus/ thar rgyan/ sdom gsum bcas kyi zhib khrid dang /pad+ma dbang grags sogs la/ nag rtsis nyer mkho bum bzang bslabs/ rgyun par skye bo pho mo rnams la chos sbyin ji ltar bstsal ba'i tshul ni/ rje nyid kyis gus par bstsal ba'i gsung bris las/ dge ba la mos pa'i skye bo pho mo ji srid 'tsho ba'i bar du/ nya stong brgyad gsum la gso sbyong gi sdom pa len par 'dod pa rnams la/ skyabs sems sngon du 'gro ba'i gso sbyong yan lag brgyad pa'i sdom pa stabs cig tu sbyin pa yang byas/ yang skye bo pho mo/ rang gi gza' zla las gzhan pa bsten rgyu spangs nus pa 'dug zer ba rnams la/sna gcig spyod pa'i sdom pa tshig gi sgo nas sbyin pa yang byas/snyung gnas dang / bsnyen gnas sogs 'dod pa rnams la de 54

'jam pal 4tho ba nyi mi'i mdza mabazhin du gang shes byas/ rgan pa rnams la tshangs spyod dge bsnyen zhus na legs tshul gyis bskul ma yang ci nus byas/de min skye bo shes rab cung zad yod pa rnams la spyod 'jug dang / bshes spring sogs 'dod pa bzhin du bslab khul byas/ 'on kyang de ltar gzhan la chos 'chad pa'i khul byas kyang / rang la the tshom dang bral ba'i shes rab med cing /rgyud la 'byor ba'i nyams myong yang med par brten/ phan thogs rgya cher mi 'byung ba ni smos ma dgos la/ phan thog byung na snyam pa'i lhag bsam ni phran bu yod lags/ shes gsungs pa bzhin du gang la gang 'os su gzigs pas dus thung ngus chod che ba gtso bo bshags sdom gyi tshul la sbyor ba mdzad do/ /mtha' dang zad du med pa'i chu gter che/ /ji snyed chu rgyun sdud la brel ba bzhin/ /yongs rdzogs gdam pa'i gter gyur 'dren pa mchog /da dung chos tshul dpag med len la 55

'jam pal 4sna ba nyi mi'i mdza maspro/ /drung rams dge slong dbang 'dus las/ mi bskyod rdo rje'i khrid thung brgya rtsa'i pod chen gcig dang / mi pham gsung dkon mchog rjes dran dang / bshes spring 'grel ba sogs pod gsum dang / dol po'i rgyud bla'i 'grel ba bcas kyi lung gsan/bla ma dbang rdor las/ do ha mdzod brgyad dang / tshig gsum gnad brdeg mkha' lding gaXrtog rlab bcas kyi khrid lung gsan/ mkhan ye shes chos dar las/ jo bo'i byang chub lam sgron gyi lung gsan/ nyid kyi zhal slob mkhan bstan pa rab rgyas las/ gsang 'dus rtsa rgyud/ chos dbyings bstod pa bcas kyi lung gsan/ zhal slob karma dgon gyi sgrub bla rnam sras bsod nams las/ zab mo nang don rang 'grel dang / jo bo'i chos chung brgya rtsa/ kong sprul rgyud bla'i 'grel ba dang / brtag gnyis spyi don/ zhal gdams skor sna tshogs pod gsum bcas kyi lung gsan/ 'brug dkar bla 56

'jam pal 4sta ba nyi mi'i mdza mam phrin las rnam rgyal las/ shag rin pas mdzad pa'i bde mchog 'grel ba pod gcig kyi rdor 'grel ba pod gcig bcas kyi lung gsan/ lci bla skrul sku'i mdun nas/ lha mchog rdo rje'i dgongs gter las/ tshe sgrub/ khyung nag rta mgrin/ smyo gcod/ lo tri/ 'jigs byed/ drag sngags bcas kyi dbang lung dang / nor lha kun 'dus/ brtan ma sogs kyi lung bcas gsan bzhes gnang /bstan pa'i nang mdzod dam chos 'dul ba nas/ /bla med rgyud kyi rgyal por thug gi bar/ /lugs 'di'i bshad dang sgrub pa'i rgyun bzang po/ /gnas 'di khyod kyi lag rjes yin zhes gleng / /me glang lo nas 'dzi sgar dgon du dbyar gnas tshugs te/dbyar gnas lo gsum bzhugs ring / sngar bstan pa ma nyams pa'i dus su lo bcu gcig dbyar gnas bzhugs shing / de dus byang 'dren pa dang / dbyar bdag mkhan 57

'jam pal slotho ba nyi mi'i mdza mapo bcas mdzad myong ba'i mthong goms la brten cung zad tsam yang ma brjed pas 'dul ba'i phyag len dang / 'don rta dbyangs sogs tshul bzhin du bslabs/me byi lor dpal chen dgon pa'i mkhan po zhal slob dbang chen sogs la gzhi gsum gyi pyag len dang / mi la'i bla sgrub/ 11na ma'i maṇ+ḍal bcas kyi 'don rta dbyangs bcas bslabs/chu rta lor 'jo phu dgon pas gdan zhus kyis zhabs sor bkod de/ gzhi gsum gyi phyag len zhib rgyas su bslabs/de'ang mthong ba brgyud pa'i phyag bzhes dang / 'dul gzhung rtsa 'grel/ 'jam mgon kong sprul rin po che'i zhib mo rnam gsal bcas la khung bcol nas shin tu dag par mdzad/sngar dbyar gyi nang du 'don chog shin tu rgyas pa 'don srol yod 'dug par brten/ 'dir phyogs gzhan nas phebs pa'i dpe cha ba mang zhing / dpe khrid dang chos grwar 'gro rgyu'i 58

'jam pal ོ ba nyi mi'i mdza mdus tshod kyang mi 'dug pas ji ltar bya zhus pas/ thos sogs 'phel ba de dbyar gyi dgos pa gtso bo gcig yin/dbyar tshogs nang gi chos 'chad nyan de tsam las med na rgyas par thon/ de min rgyun chags gsum pa dang spyod pa bka' rtags kyi phyag rgya bzhi sogs nges par dgos rigs phud/ 'brug lugs kyi 'don cha sogs chos 'chad nyan gyi babs dang bstun nas gang 'gro bya ba las 'os ci yod gsungs te/ 'dul gzhung rang nas byung ba rnams snga ma sor bzhag byas/ de min phyis bsnan pa rnams las cung zad bsdus pa bya tshul zhig gsungs pa de phran gyis zin bris su btab/ de dus 'jo phu dgon du kun mkhyen pad dkar gsung phyag chen zin bris/ chos drug zin bris/ rten 'brel gyi sgom rim za ma tog rten 'brel kho ba'i lugs/ rnal 'byor bzhi bshad/ khrid chen brgyad mdzes par byed pa'i rgyan/ 'ba' ra ba'i gsung dag snang zhing sbyang gi khrid/59

'jam pal 4tho ba nyi mi'i mdza mabyams snying rje byang chub sems kyi gter mdzod/ chos brgyad mgo snyoms kyi khrid/ chos kyi snang ba'i gsung nā ro'i gsang spyod kyi dmigs rim/ rgod tshangs pa'i gsung chos rje 'brug pa'i khyad chos bla mar mos gus kyi khrid de dpal ldan 'brug pa'i gdams zab khrid chen brgyad kyi myong khrid bka' drin ba455/de bzhin du ljongs gnas dgon/ 'bru che r+ghaṃ dgon/ he ru dgon bcas la gzhi gsum gyi phyag len bslabs/shing sprel lor bka' brgyud dgun chos dwags brgyud bgro gleng tshogs pas gdan zhus kyis dgun chos dbu bzhugs su dpal me dgon du chibs bsgyur gnang / der tshogs pa'i grwa mang la zab mo nang don gyi rtsa ba'i ljags lung gnang /skye dgu nang bstan slob gling du rgyud brtag gnyis kyi rtsa ba'i ljags lung gsungs/ dgun dus su/ gser rta mkhan po 'chi med rig 'dzin dang / 'jo phu mkhan po blo 'phrin/60

'jam pal 4sna ba nyi mi'i mdza mdakar g.yang sogs la rgyud brtag gnyis dang / zab mo nang don bcas kyi khrid gnang /me khyi lo ste mkhan rin po che dgung grangs gya gsum la phebs skabs/ skyo brag dgon pas gdan zhus bzhin mkhan po sangs rgyas dang lhan du skyo brag dgon du zhabs sor bkod de/ grwa btsun sum brgya skor la rab byung dang bsnyen rdzogs sgrub/ rta nya'i skabs sde mang la bka' slob dang /bshad grwa ba la zhal gdam bcas gnang /'brug pa dgon du a lde'u rin po ches rgyud rdo rje phreng ba'i dbang lung btsugs sar zhabs bkod kyis yongs rdzogs gsan bzhes gnang /me phag lor/ 'dzi sgar dgon du bka' 'gyur gyi lung grwa tshugs skabs rgyal bka' rin po che'i lung gsan/bar bar du 'dzi sgar dgon du dkyil 'bor bcu gnyis kyi ljags lung thengs gnyis dang / bla ma a sangs gcesas pa'i 61

'jam pal 4tshe ba nyi mi'i mdza mgrwa mang la/ mkhas dbang sangs rgyas rdo rje'i gsung 'bum pod brgyad/ kun gzigs chos snang gsung 'bum pod bzhi/ dwags po'i gsung 'bum pod bzhi/ yig rnying gi skor pod lnga/ phyag chen rgya gzhung pod gsum/ mi'i 'gur 'bum mdzod nag ma/ snyan rgyud yig gsar pod gcig lha rtse ba'i gsung 'bum pod gcig gling ras gsung 'bum pod gnyis/rgya ras gsung 'bum pod gcig bcas kyi ljags lung bka'adrin stsal ba lags so/ /rnam dag khrims kyis brjed pa'i lhun po la/ /mang thos kha ba'i rdul rab g.yos pa las/ /g.yo med srid na mngon par mtho ba'i dpal/ /bsam gtan mchog grub blo bzang rgyal gyur cig/phan bde'i 'byung gnas thub bstan pad dkar tshal/ /mtha' yas 'gro ba'i dpyid du 'jo ba'i slad/ /phrin las zer brgya phyogs mthar spro ba'i gnyen/ /yang dag don brgyud 62

'jam pal 4tshe ba nyi mi'i mdza mnyi mas zhing 'di skyongs/ / yongs rdzogs gdams pa'i rin chen 'byung ba'i gnas/ /bshad dang sgrub pa'i phrin las dus kyi char/ /skal ldan gdul bya'i zhing sar 'beb mkhas pa'i/ /mkhan chen dge legs rgya ma31 brtan bzhugs garbe1la/ /kha spyor yan lag bdun ldan he ru ka /gdul bya'i mos ngor mkhas btsun bzang po'i dpal/ /'dren pa mnyam med dpal ldan bla ma yis/ /tshe rabs kun tu rjes su bzung du gsol/ / da ltar log pa'i dpung rnams dbang che zhing / /de'i rjes phyogs pa mang dag mthong ba'i tshe/ /ma dag snang bar sems kyang bdag gdung bas/ /mgon po khyod kyis dbugs dbyung stsal du gsol/ /dus kyi btsun bzugs go kha'i g.yog po 'ga'/ /skya min ser min lam nas rgyug mthong tshe/ /mgon khyod khyim nas nges par 'byung ba'i blos/ /rab tu byung ba'i 63

'jam pal 4sna ba nyi mi'i mdza mgatam des bdag yid drangs/ /thos pas blo mig ma dag rmongs rgan 'ga'/ /a ma'i dge phrug nyid du gyur mthong tshe/ /blang dor tshul bzhin ston pa'i bshes gnyen mchog /gus pas bsten pa'i tshul de ngang gis 'char/ /drin len log pas 'jal ba'i gson 'dre 'gas/ /ma rgan khyi las lod par 'di mthong tshe/ /'gro kun pha mar shes pas gzhan don du/ /rang don 'dor ba nus pa'i tshul de gleng / /skyabs yul 'dre la re ba'i mkhas rlom 'gas/ /skyabs gcig mgon po dor ba'i gtam thos tshe/ /dpal ldan bla ma mnyes pa'i nyams len la/ /rtse gcig gzhol ba'i tshul de ngang gis 'char/ /srang mdor khyi bzhin nyul ba'i bsam gtan gyis/ / cho ga bsags pas sems la ma phan tshe/ /sems sbyong zab mo'i ting 'dzin la gzhol ba'i/ /yang dag 'jog pa'i lag rjes ngang gis 'char/ /rang blo 'dul ba'i ched du shoms pa'i mig /gzhan nor 'gugs pa'i thabs su bgrad 64

'jam pal 4tho ba nyi mi'i mdza mapa'i tshe/ /gang la ltos pa med pa'i chog shes can/ /rnam thar gtsang ma'i tshul de ngang gis 'char/ /bcas ldan tshogs su glu gar rol mo yis/ /ston pa mchog la co 'dri 'di mthong tshe/ /don dang bya ba nyung ba'i brtul zhugs kyis/ /rang rgyud bsrungs pa'i tshul de ngang gis 'char/ /rmongs pa dga' skyed dgon pa'i srol lugs zhes/ /nang khrims phan med tshegs chen 'ga' mthong tshe sems 'dul bslab pa'i grogs su 'gro ba la/ /bag kyis gzhol ba'i tshul de ngang gis 'char/ /zang zing nor gyis thub bstan 'dzin rlom nas/ /bshad sgrub las la g.yel ba 'di mthong tshe/ /tshul gnas thos bsam bsgom la 'bad pa yis/ /rgyal bstan spel ba'i tshul de ngang gis 'char/ /chos 'dul nyin mor byed 'di bzhud pa'i gnas/ /chos sder btags kyang khyim pa'i grong nag tu/ /mthong tshe gzhi gsum phyag len gzhung bzhin du/ /ji ltar gsal ba'i tshul de ngang 65

'jam pal 47 ba nyi mi'i mdza mgis 'char/ /rang phyogs 'dod pas skyor ba'i 'chad nyan gyis/ /bsod zad lam du bkris pa'i gtam thos che/ /gzur gnas rigs pa'i lam du sbyor ba yi/ /bka' drin gnang ba'i tshul de ngang gis 'char/ /zer zlos bskyar ba'i rtsig skud breg 'phro la/ /blo rtse gtad sa gang yang ma mthong tshe/ /gzhung don rigs pas 'gyed pa'i rnam dpyod kyis/ /ji ltar 'chad pa'i tshul de ngang gis 'char/ /go bshad 'phur ma lding gi kun mkhyen 'ga'/ /dogs slong tshig gis zhal ngo rog gyur tshe/ /ji tsam zhus pas de tsam dgyes bzhin du/ /dka' gnas gsal ba'i tshul de ngang gis 'char/ /gzhung lugs che rnams 'chad pa'i tshangs chen gyis/ /bstan don yongs rdzogs rtogs pa'i khul ston tshe/ /khyod kyis skabs 'gar gnas 'di mi mkhyen ces/ /zog rdzun 'gog pa'i tshul de ngang gi 'char / /go tshor med pa'i khyi 'go jo yus dbang / /blun po dga' ba skyed byed 'di mthong tshe/ /66

'jam pal 4sna ba nyi mi'i mdza masems la gsung rab rin chen sgron me yis/ /dbang mchog bskur ba'i tshul de ngang gis 'char/ /hrul po'i gos gyon dman pa'i sa bzung zhing / /tshul khrims dri bsung 'thul ba'i zhabs 'og tu/ /'chad dang rtsod dang rtsom pa'i dga' ston la/ /rtag tu spyod pa'i skal bzang reg gyur cig /de ltar lung rtogs bstan pa'i mdzod 'dzin mkhan rin po che mchog gi mdzad rnam bsam gyis mi khyab par bzhugs pa las nyung zad cig zur du bkol ba 'di ni/ 'ga' res/sku bltams pa'i gnas/ gzhi snying me tog gis brgyan pa'i zhing dang / 'dzam bu'i gling sogs ngos 'dzin gyis phal po che dang / mngon mdzod 'jig rten bstan pa sogs bkod de spros pa lta bu dang / gang la zhugs pa'i chos brgyud kyi che ba sogs brjod pa'i sgo nas chos 'byung gis bskangs ba sogs mdzad pa ni skabs don min pa'i bshad yams ni/67

'jam pal ོ ba nyi mi'i mdza mayig tshogs la re ba tsam las skabs 'dir dgos med du sems te bzhag de min sku las rin bsrel byon pa dang /lha sku'i rnam par mjal tshul sogs kyang re zhig ma bris/ bla ma'i rnam thar rjes 'jug gi nyams len zhes bya bas/ thos pa'i snying po sgrub pa la gzhol zhing / bsgrubs pa'i 'bras bu mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyi sgo nas bstan pa dang sems can gyi don bla na med par mdzad pa'i tshul 'di las lhag pa'i ngo mtshar ba dang ya mtshan pa gang yang ma dmigs shing /tshul 'di lta bu zhig thos na/ phyi rabs kyi gdul bya/ thos bsam sgom pa/ lta ba spyod pa sogs phyogs re'i mig can rnams la cung zad phan du re bas/ sgro bskur spangs te go bde'i ngag gis mgon po gangatsogi slob 'bangs yongs kyi tha shal ba dge legs dar rgyas su 'bod pas/ sa byi zla ba gsum/ par lha ldan nas bris pa'o/ / dge'o/ /du8
